title: hubHomeNeedsTarget
responsibility: Decides where a clicked notification lands as Home's asks arrive.

inputs.name: needsTarget.needs
inputs.description: The item id or "all" named by the click, or null.

inputs.name: needsTarget.asks
inputs.description: The open asks Home currently lists.

inputs.name: needsTarget.waited
inputs.description: True once Home has had long enough to read them.

outputs.name: needsTarget
outputs.description: Wait, one ask's session, the list, or nothing.
